assets.name: clouds
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production background artwork for a responsive desktop weather widget, landscape 1536x1024. Edge-to-edge sky artwork, no land, no text, no numbers, no UI, no weather symbols, no borders, no watermark.
